name: Every Peripheral Coordinate Is Admissible
statement: In a member of $\mathcal R_{\mathrm{per}}$, every peripheral coordinate may be chosen at the root of a peripheral-expansion tree, and choices may be made independently at later nodes.
proof: The contraction base and duplicated site are the two convex semicubes. Convex-subgraph closure puts both in the class, so expansion trees for them can be attached below the chosen root.
